::: {#rem-perfect-secrecy-source}
#### Source of the definition and the theorem

[Perfect secrecy](#def-perfect-secrecy) and the [theorem on the key](#thm-perfect-secrecy-key-entropy) are from [@shannon1949communication].
The proof above uses only the [chain rule](entropy.qmd#thm-entropy-chain-rule) and [conditioning reduces entropy](entropy.qmd#cor-conditioning-reduces-entropy),
both of which are results about [entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy).

:::
